dogecoin.text: @PeterSchiff You clearly have no clue how Bitcoin or Dogecoin works. Or any cryptocurrency I'd imagine. That's why you keep yelling about gold. It's all you understand.
There is less and less and less #Bitcoin and there is more and more and more #Dogecoin. That's the entire tweet.

@Helloimmorgan @jonathanhaley82 @jasondebolt I don’t think any of you understand how Dogecoin works. It’s too inflationary. Elon Musk does this for fun. If he really believed in it he would put it in one of his company’s balance sheets like he did with Bitcoin. You’re the butt of his joke.

The people who invest in Dogecoin don’t understand anything about cryptocurrency. They hear a celeb talk about it and they jump in. These are people who may never had ever put money into crypto. Now that they’re in they’re more likely to be exposed to Bitcoin.
